title: Tibni
summary: Rival of Omri for the northern kingdom of Israel. Jones dates the civil war and Tibni’s death.
description: Rival of Omri for the northern kingdom of Israel. Jones dates the civil war and Tibni’s death. Appendix F prints no end year, so no span is stored.

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (Ussher–Jones). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: 3075 929 Civil war – Tibni against Omri.

death.date: 3079 925 Tibni dies, Omri rules Israel alone
death.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
death.note: This row dates Tibni’s death. The same words also date Omri’s sole rule, on omri.

reign.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
reign.note: Jones prints the civil war against Omri as Tibni’s accession. No separate event was created. Appendix F prints no end year, so no span is stored.
